name: DELFI SIRI ET Rhein-Ruhr
description: Passenger platforms from a community mirror of DELFI SIRI ET.

delfi-siri-et-rhein-ruhr.purpose: Passenger platform assignments for strictly matched DELFI trains in the Rhein-Ruhr feed.
delfi-siri-et-rhein-ruhr.dataSent: No user data is sent. One regional feed is downloaded server-side and matched locally.
delfi-siri-et-rhein-ruhr.dataReceived: Platform names, service dates, train references, stop sequences and source timestamps.
